credential pairs for several meridiancoldchain.com addresses. One pair is for nadia.delacroix@meridiancoldchain.com. The password
in the dump matches the pattern of a previously used corporate password for this user
(hash comparison performed with the client's identity team, see ticket HD-43105).

ago, i.e. BEFORE the dump was posted. The exposed credential is therefore believed to be
current.

Recommendation: force password reset and MFA enrolment for ACC-8277; review legacy
protocol access (IMAP/POP) which bypasses MFA in this tenant.

The same combolist contained no other meridiancoldchain.com addresses.
</document>

args.reasoning:
ACC-7456 (Aisha Brandt): sign-in from Lagos (127.224.173.32, unmanaged Linux) 40 minutes after a Rotterdam managed-laptop login (DOC-031). A forwarding/delete inbox rule "." was created from the same Lagos IP (DOC-027). The fraudulent Kestrel IBAN change WR-3763 came from the same IP (DOC-011). The urgent email falsely claimed CFO approval (DOC-015), and Sofia and Kestrel both denied it (DOC-010, DOC-020).
ACC-7249 (Jonas Novak): MFA fatigue. Eleven prompts from the same Lagos IP, ending in an APPROVED at 03:16 UTC (DOC-023, DOC-007). A minute earlier the attacker's session granted an unverified "MailSync Pro" OAuth app Mail.ReadWrite, Mail.Send and offline_access (DOC-018). Jonas confirms he approved a prompt he didn't initiate.
ACC-8277 (Nadia Delacroix): her credential was in a leaked combolist and her password predated the leak, so it was still valid (DOC-025, DOC-013). Legacy IMAP bypasses MFA. A password-only login came from Karachi on an unfamiliar device (DOC-031). A phishing invoice then went out in her name with a lookalike Reply-To domain, meridian-coldchain.com (DOC-021).
Not compromised: ACC-5289 (Sofia) is in Barcelona as announced, on a managed device over VPN (DOC-016, DOC-031). ACC-2059 (Tomas) had failed logins only from his own laptop, and his identity was verified in person (DOC-001). ACC-6320 (Felix) and ACC-5846 (Priya) show normal activity. ACC-3892 (Rafael) made a legitimate verified-app admin consent.
